title: Outdated jQuery
description: An outdated version of jQuery was detected. Versions below 3.5.0 are vulnerable to XSS.

title: Outdated Bootstrap
description: An outdated version of Bootstrap was detected.

title: Outdated AngularJS
description: An outdated version of AngularJS was detected. AngularJS is end-of-life.
remediation: Migrate to Angular (v2+) or upgrade AngularJS to >= 1.8.0

title: Outdated Lodash
description: An outdated version of Lodash was detected. Versions below 4.17.21 have command injection vulnerabilities.

title: Exposed .git Directory
description: Git repository configuration is publicly accessible. Source code and credentials may be exposed.
remediation: Block access to .git directory in your web server configuration.

title: WordPress Detected
description: WordPress CMS detected via common path patterns.
remediation: Ensure WordPress and all plugins are up to date.

title: WordPress Version Disclosure
description: WordPress version is disclosed via meta generator tag.
remediation: Remove the generator meta tag and keep WordPress updated.

title: PHP Version Disclosed in Headers
description: PHP version is disclosed via X-Powered-By header.
remediation: Set expose_php = Off in php.ini to hide version information.

title: Directory Listing Enabled
description: Directory listing is enabled, exposing file structure to attackers.
remediation: Disable directory listing in web server configuration.

pattern: stack trace|traceback \(most recent|fatal error|parse error|syntax error.*on line
title: Application Error Information Leak
description: Application error details are exposed, potentially revealing internal paths and code structure.
remediation: Implement custom error pages and disable debug mode in production.

title: Mixed Content (HTTP resources on HTTPS page)
description: The page loads resources over insecure HTTP while served over HTTPS.
remediation: Update all resource URLs to use HTTPS.

title: Email Address Disclosed
description: Email addresses were found in the page source.
remediation: Consider using contact forms instead of exposing email addresses.

title: Internal IP Address Disclosure
description: Internal/private IP addresses are exposed in the page source.
remediation: Remove internal IP addresses from public-facing pages.
